tooltip.oritech_extensions.upgrade.void: Items that don't fit are deleted instead of backing up, for items the vault already holds.
tooltip.oritech_extensions.upgrade.pull: Pulls the vault's items from the inventories on the sides you pick in the upgrade screen.
tooltip.oritech_extensions.upgrade.push: Pushes the vault's items into the inventories on the sides you pick in the upgrade screen.
tooltip.oritech_extensions.upgrade.redst: The vault gives off a redstone signal as strong as it is full. A redstone signal pauses Pull and Push.
tooltip.oritech_extensions.upgrade.help: Right-click a vault with it, or sneak + right-click the vault to open its upgrades.

tooltip.oritech_extensions.fluid_vault.e: Empty. Holds lots of one fluid.
